# port/test/CMakeLists.txt: cross-cutting tests of the game's sources.
#
# layout_asserts (package 2B, docs/port/LAYOUT.md): the struct layouts of the
# game's headers as _Static_asserts, generated by tools/gen_layout_asserts.py
# from the headers' offset comments and config/struct_classes.txt. It is
# compiled as the game compiles (include path, definitions, record layout
# options), so a layout that moves fails the build. Only the frozen structs'
# asserts apply on the host (disc and ELF overlays, save records); the
# runtime structs' EE-layout asserts compile with -DICO_LAYOUT_EE=1 only.

ico_include_dirs(common _ico_layout_incs)
add_executable(layout_asserts layout_asserts.c)
target_include_directories(layout_asserts PRIVATE ${_ico_layout_incs})
target_compile_definitions(layout_asserts PRIVATE ${ICO_GAME_DEFINITIONS})
target_compile_options(layout_asserts PRIVATE ${ICO_SEMANTIC_OPTIONS} ${ICO_GAME_LAYOUT_OPTIONS}
                       ${ICO_GAME_WARNINGS})

if(NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING OR CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR
   OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL CMAKE_HOST_SYSTEM_NAME)
    # the asserts hold at compile time; running the program only says so
    add_test(NAME layout_asserts COMMAND layout_asserts)
endif()

# The committed layout_asserts.c must match the headers and the
# classification: rerun tools/gen_layout_asserts.py after changing either.
if(Python3_FOUND)
    add_test(NAME layout_asserts_fresh
             COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/gen_layout_asserts.py" --check)
endif()

# offset_audit (docs/port/OFFSET_AUDIT.md): every raw EE-offset access the host
# compiles (ICO_RAW/ICO_RAWP, (char *)x + 0xNN, ((int *)x)[N], scalar and record
# views of a record, pad<HEX> members) checked against the named field at that
# EE offset, through host offsetof probes. It preprocesses and probes the game
# units of this build's compile_commands.json with the build's own compiler, so
# it runs on native builds only.
if(Python3_FOUND AND CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS AND NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    add_test(NAME offset_audit
             COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/offset_audit.py"
                     --build "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
    set_tests_properties(offset_audit PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 900)
    # template_audit (docs/port/OFFSET_AUDIT.md, "Whole-record copies"): every
    # record copied whole over storage of another record type (a template
    # moved through a view, memcpy between two record types) must have its
    # layout registered with static assertions in its unit; unregistered
    # copies and host layout differences fail.
    add_test(NAME template_audit
             COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/template_audit.py"
                     --build "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
    set_tests_properties(template_audit PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 900)
endif()
